subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The bowler signalled the wicket-keeper to __catch__ the ball.
solution:
The correct answer is: **'****Drop**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"catch"** means to seize or capture something that is moving or being thrown. (पकड़ना)

 
 
• **Example: **The fielder managed to **catch **the ball just before it hit the ground.
 
 
 
• **"Drop" **refers to letting something fall or allowing it to fall unintentionally. (गिराना)
 
 
• **Example: **Be careful not to **drop **the glass; it might break.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'catch'** is **'drop'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Give **(देना): To present voluntarily and without expecting compensation.

 
 
• **Example:** She decided to **give **her old clothes to charity.
 
 
 
• **Change **(बदलना): To make or become different.
 
 
• **Example: **He had to **change **his plans due to the bad weather.
 
 
 
• **Throw** (फेंकना): To propel something with force through the air by a movement of the arm and hand.
 
 
• **Example:** He can **throw **a ball farther than anyone else on the team.
